scope: Proposition 2.5 (Gaussian target) of the manuscript “Hard-sphere fluctuations on the regular Boltzmann lifespan” (preprints/Hard-sphere-fluctuations-on-the-regular-Boltzmann-lifespan-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 364 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e294d8e5097f8d0e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The fluctuation equation in Theorem 1.2 has a centered Gaussian solution on the test scales E0 a, 0 ≤ a < β. It is a continuous linear map from each such test space to L2 of its probability space, uniformly on [0, T]. Its covariance is E[ζt(ϕ)ζs(ψ)] = ∫ f0(z) U(0, t)ϕ(z) U(0, s)ψ(z) dz + ∫ min(s,t) 0 Cr ( U(r, t)ϕ, U(r, s)ψ ) dr. (2.23) It is unique in the class of solutions extending to these scales with uniformly bounded second-moment operator norms. In particular, the law required in Theorem 1.2 is well defined.
